description: Aave V4 per-user risk-premium history. Returns the user's risk-premium snapshots over time (one per RefreshPremium event), plus the latest premium and the spoke it was set on. Use for: agent-side modeling of a borrower's risk drift, identifying users approaching liquidation, or auditing premium accrual against AaveKit's aggregate risk view. Data AaveKit's REST API doesn't expose.
name: get_v4_user_risk_trajectory
